tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.description: Add an available catalog item with selected options to the active cart session identified by cartId. To inspect full cart totals and lines, use get_cart. To modify existing lines, use update_cart.

cartId.description: Optional unique cart session ID. If omitted, uses active session cart.

itemId.description: The unique itemId (preferred) or exact natural title of the item to add (e.g. "item_vegan_avocado" or "Avocado Tartine"). If both match, itemId takes precedence.

quantity.description: Quantity of the item to add.

variantSelections.description: Key-value map of variant group names to selected option labels (e.g. { Portion: "Large" }) matching options returned by get_item_details.

notes.description: Special preparation instructions or customer notes.

clearExisting.description: Clear existing cart items before adding, ensuring clean cross-venue isolation.

tools.name: apply_coupon
tools.description: Apply a promotional coupon code or discount voucher to the active shopping cart session identified by cartId. Recalculates discounts and updates the cart subtotal and final total.

couponCode.description: The promotional discount or coupon code to apply (e.g. SAVE10, WELCOME20, PACY50).

cartId.description: Optional cart session identifier. If omitted, applies to the active session cart.

tools.name: create_cart
tools.description: Initialize a new shopping cart session for the customer. Returns an authoritative cartId session handle. To inspect existing cart contents, use get_cart. To add items, use add_to_cart.

tableIdentifier.description: Optional table number, room, or seat identifier.

tools.name: find_venue
tools.description: Search and discover distinct external merchant venues or franchise branch locations across the WETAEGO network directory by keyword, city, or business name. Returns venue profiles and URLs. Does NOT switch internal department tabs within an active venue (use open_business_page for department switching).

query.description: Optional free-text keyword or location search (e.g. "Lagos sushi", "spa Lekki"). All filters are optional; an empty call returns the current venue directory listing.

name.description: Exact or partial business name (e.g. "Pacy Group", "Emerald Cafe").

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Inspect the contents of the active cart session identified by cartId, including line items, modifier options, subtotal, discounts, and final total. Does NOT initialize a new cart session (use create_cart).

cartId.description: Optional unique cart session ID to inspect. If omitted, returns active session cart.

tools.name: get_item_details
tools.description: Return authoritative details for a catalog item, including price, availability, modifiers, dietary tags and applicable options.

tools.name: initiate_checkout
tools.description: Validate the current cart and prepare a checkout session. Locks pricing for 15 minutes. Does not authorize payment or charge customer.

fulfillment.description: Fulfillment method for the order: "dine_in" (in-house table service), "pickup" (counter takeout), or "delivery" (room or delivery address). Defaults to "dine_in".

tableIdentifier.description: Table number, room, suite, seat, or pickup counter (e.g. "Table 12" or "12").

phone.description: Customer contact phone number in standard international E.164 format (e.g. +12025550123 or +2348012345678).

tools.name: open_business_page
tools.description: Switch between internal departments or category tabs (dining, spa, boutique, stays, repairs, media) within the active merchant storefront. Does NOT search or navigate external merchant venues (use find_venue for venue discovery).

conceptSlug.description: Department or category slug to navigate to within the storefront. Must be one of the 23 supported department slugs or aliases in the enum: dining concepts ("dining", "menu", "restaurant", "bar"), wellness ("spa", "wellness", "treatments"), retail ("boutique", "retail", "shop", "apparel", "electronics"), stays ("stays", "hotel", "rooms", "suites"), repairs ("repairs", "services", "diagnostics", "quotes"), or media ("media", "studio", "rate-card").

tools.name: recommend_pairings
tools.description: Suggest complementary catalog items, sides, drinks, or accessories based on the current cart or a specific item ID.

itemId.description: Optional focal item ID to find pairings for. If omitted, uses current cart items.

maxRecommendations.description: Maximum number of pairing recommendations to return.

tools.name: request_staff
tools.description: Send an immediate service or waiter call notification to venue floor staff.

tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search the current venue catalog for products, dishes, services, and available variants. Supports dietary filtering and pagination.

dietary.description: Dietary classification filter tags for dining and food venues.

maxPrice.description: Maximum price in major currency units.

currency.description: Optional target currency code (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP, NGN) for dynamic rate conversion.

inStockOnly.description: Filter only items currently available in stock.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (1-100).

tools.name: submit_order
tools.description: Submit the previously reviewed checkout as a customer order after explicit human authorization. High-Impact Sensitive Action.

confirmed.description: Must be explicitly confirmed by human customer.

tools.name: update_cart
tools.description: Modify the quantity or notes of an existing line item in the cart session using lineId and quantity (set quantity to 0 to remove the line). Requires both lineId and quantity. Does NOT add new catalog items (use add_to_cart).

cartId.description: Optional unique cart session ID. If omitted, updates active cart.

lineId.description: The lineId (cartKey) of the item to update.

quantity.description: New quantity for the line item (0-50). Set to 0 to remove the line item from the cart.
